name: Independent Major (BS)
scope: Advisor-approved primary and secondary areas. Engineering common curriculum follows the selected primary area.

manual.label: Faculty-approved engineering curriculum
manual.instruction: Confirm the two approved areas, advisor approvals, engineering design and synthesis, and the primary area's common curriculum. Computer Science cannot serve as the primary area. Pre-health cannot serve as the secondary area.

manual.label: Degree credits and engineering requirements
manual.instruction: Confirm the 123-credit engineering degree minimum and the applicable common curriculum with Engineering Advising.
